questions.question: When the prophet Jeremiah tried to stop speaking in the LORD's name, what did the LORD's message become to him?

answers.text: A fire burning in his heart
A stone sitting on his chest
A chain wrapped around his neck

questions.question: The prophet Jeremiah said some people were watching for him to fall. Who were they?
The prophet Jeremiah said the LORD was with him like a fearsome warrior. What did he say would happen to his persecutors?

answers.text: They will stumble and not prevail
